Enclosed printer, nozzle 245–255 °C, bed 100–105 °C, fan ≤ 20 %, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 25 % gyroid, brim on tall or long parts, door shut until cool; XY shrink compensation from the tolerance coupon (M03.3).
